measurement: Advance uses real .katex-base width; natural ascent/depth uses direct .katex-strut rectangles. Text origins use zero-size baseline markers; actual computed CSS visibility/color and shadows, span backgrounds/four border edges, and SVG shape-child CTMs are retained. CSS equation-counter characters and bounds come from Chrome DOMSnapshot resolved pseudo-layout, never counter guesses. Contextual text runs retain original text, actual DOM Range advance and baseline. Invalid facade cases separately retain actual colored-source HTML/PNG; no fabricated MathML when absent. No C# data used.
